name: Art Gallery
summary:
Put on the headset and step into a museum that never closes. No queues, no ropes, no glass in the way: lean into The Starry Night until you see the brushstrokes, stand alone with Las Meninas for as long as you like, and turn your head to find a nine-metre Stegosaurus breathing beside you.

FOUR MUSEUMS IN ONE

MASTERS OF PAINTING. Ten rooms, one per artist: Van Gogh, Da Vinci, Monet, Vermeer, Rembrandt, Klimt, Goya, Velázquez, Botticelli and Hokusai. Forty masterpieces at gallery scale, each with its own sp
